primary_sources.publisher: Evernorth Holdings Inc. filing with SEC

source_capture_policy.note: Public SEC-rendered filing text and official EFFECT notice were reviewed. Raw wire bytes, response headers and signed SEC receipts were not retained.

reconciliation.treatment_of_261919096: A component figure within the private-placement XRP disclosures; do not add it again to the 388,910,554 total in-kind closing contribution without an investor-level schedule.

verified_historical_capital.note: The $214.1m cash raised and $272.6m closing gross cash are related disclosure layers, not additive. The $214.1m cash was used to purchase XRP; in-kind XRP is a separate contribution category.

convertible_notes.trustee: NH Investment & Securities Co., as trustee of Kyobo AIM Corporate Finance General Private Investment Trust No. 3

company_facility.description: The prospectus says confirmed amounts drawn included certain third-party payments Ripple made on behalf of the Company and Evernorth; do not treat the full amount as direct XRP purchases.

evernorth_facility.description: The prospectus states Evernorth had not borrowed under this separate $1.0m revolving facility as of June 30, 2026.

custody_and_market.classification: Issuer accounting principal-market determination based on volume/activity, quote consistency and access/compliance criteria; not an independent ranking of every exchange and not evidence Coinbase purchased or held Evernorth XRP.

cantor_committed_equity_facility.issuer_obligation: No obligation to issue or sell; Evernorth may elect in its sole discretion.
cantor_committed_equity_facility.price_formula: 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to stated threshold/block provisions.
cantor_committed_equity_facility.maximum_share_volume_per_purchase: Lesser of beneficial-ownership cap, stated share request and 20% of trading volume during applicable period, unless parties expressly agree otherwise.

commencement.definition: The Commencement Date is when each condition to the Holder's obligations in Section 7.2 is satisfied or waived.
other_conditions_include: material accuracy of representations and warranties
effective resale registration with no stop order
Nasdaq listing approval subject to notice of issuance
legal opinions, auditor comfort letters and compliance certificates

fees_and_expenses.payment_due: Within five business days after the Upfront Determination Date; based on October 30 effectiveness, the contractual deadline fell on 2026-11-06.
fees_and_expenses.note: The envelope is a disclosed cap scenario, not an assertion that every fee was incurred or paid.

cantor_committed_equity_facility.proceeds_use: General corporate purposes, including XRP acquisition and other XRP ecosystem activities, and working capital. The issuer expects a substantial portion of any proceeds to acquire XRP, but proceeds are not exclusively ring-fenced for XRP.
cantor_committed_equity_facility.term: Until the first day of the month next following the 14-month anniversary of the October 23, 2026 agreement, unless earlier terminated.

prospectus_arithmetic_reconciliation.treatment: Flag the internal arithmetic/disclosure inconsistency; do not infer misconduct. The $14.71 cover price is a closing price, while the contractual purchase formula is based on VWAP.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The committed equity facility could produce future cash that Evernorth may partly deploy into XRP.
competing_hypotheses.support: SEC-filed agreement permits optional share sales and states expected substantial XRP use for any proceeds.
competing_hypotheses.limitations: Commencement is conditional; no drawdown, share settlement or incremental XRP purchase is publicly verified; proceeds are discretionary and also available for working capital/general corporate purposes.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The existence/effectiveness of the Cantor facility already represents new XRP spot demand.
competing_hypotheses.limitations: The facility sells Evernorth equity, not XRP; no share purchase or XRP purchase is verified.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Evernorth previously raised cash and used part of it to buy XRP.
competing_hypotheses.support: Prospectus states $214.1m cash raised, 84,365,876 XRP purchased with those proceeds, and approximately 473m XRP held as of October 9.
competing_hypotheses.limitations: Historical holding date is October 9; do not extrapolate to November 9 without current custody/filing evidence.

model_admission.actual_historical_xrp_purchase: Candidate descriptive institutional-flow feature with 2026-10-09 cutoff; requires point-in-time validation and no double counting.
model_admission.cantor_facility_capacity: NOT_A_CAPITAL_FLOW_FEATURE until commencement, share issuance and cash settlement are verified.

next_actions: Monitor EDGAR for a disclosed Commencement Date, Cantor VWAP Purchase Notices, issued shares and settlement amounts.
Check whether the $521,893.50 upfront fee was paid by the contractual November 6 deadline; do not infer payment from its due date.
Reconcile the $76.8m/$74.4m proceeds narrative and the $14.71 table row against the 97% VWAP formula and disclosed fees.
Track current XRP holdings and custody changes separately from historical October 9 balances.
Do not count private-placement cash, closing gross cash, in-kind XRP and the $30m notes twice.
